Ailment gallbladder gallstones biliary liver digestive detox

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Gallbladder dysfunction or gallstone formation causing digestion problems, bloating, and referred pain. Often linked to liver congestion.

Symptoms

  • upper right abdominal pain
  • bloating
  • nausea
  • back pain (right shoulder blade)
  • indigestion
  • loss of appetite
  • jaundice
